album.title: Maestro Ahmad Ebadi: Lord of Setar

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on As3 and dwells most on Db in Phrase 1. Phrase 5 (0:44.5) introduces As, B, centred on As. The line peaks at B4 (500.3 Hz) at 0:47.2. It closes on As4, not the tonic (Db4 → B4 → B4 → As4 → As4 → As4).
